description: Build and host your own private cell from a public GitHub repo at a commit, in a sandbox on our servers (no network, 256 MB, 10 s a call). The repo needs Cargo.toml, a committed Cargo.lock and a binary named `cell` that reads one JSON line on stdin and writes one line on stdout; example: github.com/Leif-Rydenfalk/codebox-hello. Signed-in accounts; 3 cells and 6 builds a day per account. To list it for everyone use cell_publish.
name: host_code
